protocol.score_merge: per anchor max(car,van); other mapped scores unchanged; never sum independent sigmoid scores
protocol.postprocess: map BEFORE best-class selection, class-aware NMS and top500; discard unmapped classes
protocol.preprocessing: Pinned 8.3.0 native LetterBox: max side640, minimum stride padding for same-shape batches; mixed orientations square-pad. Actual BCHW shapes recorded; rect flag does not override this old predictor.
protocol.evaluator: COCO-style 3-class bbox AP@[.50:.05:.95] after author strict-containment ignored-region prediction filter; NOT official UAVDT COCO AP
protocol.GT: original *_gt_whole.txt continuous xywh, no clipping/minus-one; deterministic sequence/frame IDs; all 375884 DET boxes
protocol.AP_small: original-image area<32^2, not the resized640 size
protocol.selection: four existing seed2/3 source-val-selected best.pt, never target-selected
protocol.native_supplement: Python port of author overall class-agnostic AP70/VOC integral math; same fixed mapped predictions; not MATLAB execution or a new official submission
protocol.ignored_regions: Remove prediction only when all four edges strictly inside a same-frame ignore region in the 18 sequences listed by author evaluator; never delete GT using ignore regions
protocol.shutdown: explicit opt-in after complete verified success and idle
protocol.caveat: Source-only direct transfer, not novel-class/open-vocabulary zero-shot. Target retraining is a different experiment.
